resources.string: DevShield requires WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS to safely suppress developer settings without root. Run this ADB command from a computer:
Developer and debugging settings are currently suppressed.
Some apps may also require the USB cable to be physically disconnected from the device.
Settings remain suppressed from a previous session or reboot. Tap below to restore your original developer options.
Snapshots your current debugging settings, temporarily disables them, verifies the changes, and optionally launches a selected app.
Disables Wireless Debugging while Protection Mode is active. Apps that rely on wireless ADB, including Shizuku, may lose their active connection and may need to be restarted afterward.
Disabling Wireless Debugging may disconnect wireless ADB services such as Shizuku. If a service stops, start it again after restoring Wireless Debugging.
Note: Wireless Debugging suppression depends on your setting. Disabling it may disconnect wireless ADB services such as Shizuku.
